criteria.description: Terminology: five accurate definitions/analogies worth 2 each (1 meaning, 1 analogy with mapping).

criteria.feedback: Missing or incorrect prediction. Trace the example and check JSON types, then retry.

criteria.description: Create two disposable users through Django APIs or management commands. Use set_password/create_user; demonstrate check_password works without saving plaintext in notes. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Use Django’s LoginView and a login template. Configure redirect paths. Show correct credentials reach a dashboard and incorrect credentials produce a useful error. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Protect dashboard with login_required. Record the anonymous redirect and authenticated 200 response. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Use a CSRF-protected POST logout form. After logout, revisit dashboard and confirm authentication is required again. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Restrict product deletion to staff or an explicit permission. Show a signed-in ordinary user denied and a permitted user allowed. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Use browser tools to identify the session cookie without copying its value into your submission. Explain the roles of HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Write tests for anonymous, normal and privileged users. Check both visible links and direct requests, proving hidden buttons alone do not enforce access. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
